name: Darren Su
headline: Connecting global founders and builders with China's AI ecosystem.
bio: Co-founder of AGI Villa and MatchPoint; Head of City Ecosystem at Datawhale; n8n Ambassador.
about: I co-founded AGI Villa and MatchPoint, and I am Head of City Ecosystem at Datawhale.

I accompanied the SuperAI team through universities, open-source communities, and AI companies in Hangzhou and Shanghai, including Zhejiang University, ModelScope, Qwen, and MiniMax, then represented Datawhale at their conference in Singapore.
I wrote five observations from those conversations. One that still sits with me: a conference week is a weak substitute for a relationship the rest of the year.
GlobalTechEvents is the index I use to pull technology conferences and community events into one calendar.
Datawhale AI+X Events is the shared calendar for AI meetups, workshops, hackathons, and university, city, and industry events.
In 2026 I also wrote about running 31 agents, including the tasks that failed and the automations I stopped.
